purpose: BMW 4 Series transmission and movement invalid-value audit; proposals for root integration, no repository edits
source: sidecar.scanlogs/db.sqlite, SQLite mode=ro and query_only=ON, selected BMW sessions only

scope.session_500: VIN matched BMW anchor in scanlog metadata; startup-to-later route comparison
scope.session_3000: VIN matched BMW anchor; 28 polls each of DA12/DA25/DA2E/DA37
scope.sessions_450_to_550: 81 VIN-matching sessions inspected for positive DA12/DA25/DA2E/DA37 responses; not a claim of complete export coverage
scope.sessions_5395_and_5397: latest BMW anchor; 5397 also has matching Mode 09 VIN response; no VIN reproduced here

schema_convention: The locally downloaded upstream signalset schema defines fmt.nullmin and fmt.nullmax as inclusive bounds on scaled values (<= and >= respectively). An isolated raw sentinel would need a safe scaled threshold; no numeric threshold is established here.

transmission.DA12: 6F1.618.22DA12|e=18,fc=1; 4SERIES_ATF_TEMP, second payload byte, raw - 48 Celsius; no null bound
transmission.DA25: 6F1.618.22DA25|e=18,fc=1; 4SERIES_EOT, second payload byte, raw - 60 Celsius; no null bound
transmission.DA2E: 6F1.618.22DA2E|e=18,fc=1; 4SERIES_GEAR, second payload byte; no null bound

proposals.classification: confirmed transport unavailability, no numeric sentinel confirmed
proposals.action: Do not add fmt.nullmin/nullmax from these samples. Retain valid positive responses; a NO DATA adapter response already contains no decoded signal. Document operational startup gaps separately if desired.

evidence.session_500_counts: Each DID had four requests: first three NO DATA and last one positive, on the same route. A 612 response to 224AB1 was available earlier in the session, so this is specifically the 618 path, not proof of total adapter failure.
evidence.other_session: Session 3000: first three valid responses for each DID, then 25 NO DATA responses each; supports transport loss, not a numeric code. Route remained 6F1/618/e18.

proposals.action: Do not set nullmin=0 or reject raw zero. Keep speed zero decodable.

evidence.session_5397_4AB1: 272 of 276 224AB1 records were positive raw 0000; four later records were NO DATA. Route ATCEA12, ATSH6F1, ATCRA612, ATFCSM1.
evidence.session_5395_4AB1: 122 raw 0000 among 293 records; other responses were nonzero, including first record raw 0525. Same 612 route.

unresolved_rejected_numeric_hypotheses.hypothesis: DA25 raw 0x30 (scaled -12 C) is a confirmed unavailable sentinel
unresolved_rejected_numeric_hypotheses.reason: In 81 VIN-matching sessions 450-550, 107 positive DA25 replies included seven 0x30 records in six sessions; a low EOT after warmer readings is suspicious but does not establish a documented invalid code. In session 526, two 0x7B responses precede 0x30 eight minutes later; the latter is a positive 618 reply near a valid gear 0006 and DA37 reply. No independent reference proves the oil temperature invalid then. A nullmin at -12 C would also remove potentially real cold temperatures.

Six positive 000A records occurred across five VIN-matching sessions 450-550. In session 513, 000A accompanied positive DA25/DA12/DA37 data and 612 speed zero. It could be an undocumented gear/status value; no availability proof or enum definition was found. The 2018 fixture also includes 000A as a supported response.

unresolved_rejected_numeric_hypotheses.hypothesis: DA2E 00FF or first response 0000, D107 00FF, or any speed raw 0000 is automatically invalid
unresolved_rejected_numeric_hypotheses.reason: Positive fixtures show 00FF and 0000 in context, but no documented gear/status semantics; D107 00FF is 25.5 km/h by configured scaling and has adjacent nonzero speed fixtures. Zero physical speed is routine. No broad lower/upper null threshold is safe.

unresolved_rejected_numeric_hypotheses.hypothesis: DA37 trailing FFFF represents an invalid counter
unresolved_rejected_numeric_hypotheses.reason: DA37 first ISO-TP frame advertises a 0x000F-byte UDS payload: 62 DA37 plus three 32-bit counters. Trailing FFFF bytes after those 15 bytes are frame padding, not any signal value.

unresolved_rejected_numeric_hypotheses.hypothesis: Odometer D10D/558E or wheel DBE4 has a proven numeric sentinel
unresolved_rejected_numeric_hypotheses.reason: Existing fixtures for D10D and DBE4 are no-data placeholders; 558E has no positive fixture. No positive outlier pattern here justifies a null bound. 558E scanlog responses can contain payload followed by FFFFFFFF padding, which must be parsed by ISO-TP length before interpreting a 32-bit field.

test_suggestions: If the root adds an invalid-values catalog, assert NO DATA on the 618 route yields no DA12/25/2E/37 signals, then a later positive response in the same session decodes normally.
Assert positive raw 0000 movement responses remain numeric zero for 4AB1, D240 and D107; do not add nullmin=0.
Assert DA25 raw 0x30 remains represented as -12 C pending independent sentinel proof; gear DA2E raw 0x0A remains numeric/unknown rather than null.
Assert DA37 FFFF trailing ISO-TP padding is excluded from all three counter fields.
